name: WiFi / URL QR Code Plaque
description: A flat plaque or fridge magnet with a QR code that joins a WiFi network, opens a web link or shows text, with an optional caption and the network name and password printed underneath. The QR encoder is plain OpenSCAD (byte mode, versions 1-10, error correction L/M/Q/H, all eight masks scored). Square, rounded or round, raised or inlaid code, optional magnet pockets and desk stand. Plate on extruder 1, code on extruder 2, caption on extruder 3 (the same black as the code by default).
source: inspired by Printables "Easy and Customizable QR Code Plaques/Fridge Magnet for WiFi"
